WSJ Opinion Piece Discusses Israel's Post-Oct 7 War Room

An opinion piece in The Wall Street Journal offers an inside look at Israel's war room discussions following the October 7th attacks. The article explores the strategic and ethical considerations faced by Israeli leadership in the aftermath of the event. It delves into the complexities of decision-making during wartime and the lessons learned from the initial response. The Jerusalem Post published a related piece reflecting on survival and responsibility through the lens of Moses.
